discussion_summary: Omar opened the meeting by presenting the business case for redesigning the e-commerce platform, highlighting a 23% drop in mobile conversion rates over the past two quarters. Walid confirmed that the client expects the new platform to be live before the Ramadan sales peak in early 2027. Saud raised concerns about the feasibility of the proposed 6-month timeline given the complexity of migrating existing product catalog data. The team agreed that a phased approach would be more realistic, with Phase 1 covering checkout optimization and mobile responsiveness. Maha presented three initial UX concepts and the team voted to proceed with the minimalist layout that tested best with focus groups. Dina noted that several functional requirements in the initial brief were vague and requested a follow-up session with the client to clarify scope boundaries before finalizing the BRD.
decisions: Phased delivery approach adopted: Phase 1 by August 2026, Phase 2 by December 2026
Minimalist UX concept approved for development
Product catalog migration will run in parallel with new feature development
Weekly status meetings scheduled every Tuesday at 10:00 AM
